doc:
# Ryu Takayanagi — Entanglement Entropy

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “Ryu-Takayanagi holographic entanglement”).

claims.name: ryutakayanagi_formula_formulated_holographic_entanglement
claims.statement: The Ryu-Takayanagi formula is formulated for holographic entanglement entropy.

sources.title: Non-relativistic entanglement entropy from Horava gravity

claims.name: holographic_ryutakayanagi_ansatz_used_compute
claims.statement: The holographic Ryu-Takayanagi ansatz is used to compute entanglement entropy.

claims.name: modification_holographic_ryutakayanagi_formula_used
claims.statement: A modification of the holographic Ryu-Takayanagi formula is used to calculate holographic entanglement measures.

sources.title: Entanglement from holography for five-dimensional charged Schrödinger black hole

claims.name: work_related_ryutakayanagi_proposal_holographic
claims.statement: The work is related to the Ryu-Takayanagi proposal for holographic entanglement entropy.

claims.name: classical_level_bulk_construction_reproduces
claims.statement: Classical level bulk construction reproduces the conjectured Ryu-Takayanagi formula for holographic entanglement entropy

claims.name: proposal_generalizes_holographic_entanglement_entropy
claims.statement: The proposal generalizes the holographic entanglement entropy of Ryu-Takayanagi to spacetime-split regions.

sources.title: EPR = ER and Scattering Amplitude as Entanglement Entropy Change

claims.name: ryu_takayanagi_formula_entanglement_entropy
claims.statement: The Ryu–Takayanagi formula for entanglement entropy appears naturally in the $p$-adic holographic setting.

sources.title: Tensor networks, $p$-adic fields, and algebraic curves: arithmetic and the AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$ correspondence

claims.name: ryu_takayanagi_conjecture_used_compute
claims.statement: The Ryu–Takayanagi conjecture is used to compute entanglement entropy in the proposed holographic dual.

sources.title: AdS Vacuum Bubbles, Holography and Dual RG Flows

claims.name: holographic_ryu_takayanagi_rt_algorithm
claims.statement: The holographic Ryu–Takayanagi (RT) algorithm computes the entanglement entropy (EE) in dual CFT$_{2}$.

sources.title: Holographic Entanglement Entropy for noncommutative Anti-de Sitter space

claims.name: holographic_entanglement_entropy_formula_ryutakayanagi
claims.statement: The holographic entanglement entropy formula of Ryu-Takayanagi appears to detect only the hidden Fermi surfaces.

sources.title: Hidden Fermi surfaces in compressible states of gauge-gravity duality

claims.name: complex_codimensiontwo_extremal_surfaces_may
claims.statement: Complex codimension-two extremal surfaces may be relevant to the Ryu-Takayanagi holographic entanglement proposal and its covariant Hubeny-Rangamani-Takayanagi generalization.

sources.title: Complex Entangling Surfaces for AdS and Lifshitz Black Holes?

claims.name: ryutakayanagi_holographic_entanglement_entropy_formula
claims.statement: The Ryu-Takayanagi holographic entanglement entropy formula calculates some terms in the entanglement entropy of entangled superpositions of coherent states.

sources.title: Holographic entanglement entropy beyond coherent states

claims.name: ads_ryu_takayanagi_holographic_entanglement
claims.statement: In AdS$_3$, Ryu–Takayanagi holographic entanglement entropy yields a maximum entanglement temperature for thermal energy near the boundary region.

sources.title: Realization of Holographic Entanglement Temperature for a Nearly-AdS boundary

claims.name: holographic_case_emphasizes_how_ryutakayanagi
claims.statement: The holographic case emphasizes how the Ryu-Takayanagi formula geometrically realizes general features of field-theory entanglement.

sources.title: Lectures on entanglement entropy in field theory and holography

claims.name: new_corrections_holographic_entanglement_entropy
claims.statement: New corrections to holographic entanglement entropy are expected near phase transitions of the associated Ryu-Takayanagi surface.

sources.title: Probing phase transitions of holographic entanglement entropy with fixed area states

claims.name: ryu_takayanagi_holographic_entanglement_entropy
claims.statement: The Ryu–Takayanagi holographic entanglement entropy proposal is evaluated in a de Sitter braneworld embedded in AdS.

sources.title: Holographic entanglement entropy of de Sitter braneworld

claims.name: minimal_area_condition_ryutakayanagi_used
claims.statement: The minimal area condition of Ryu-Takayanagi is used in the holographic calculation of the entanglement entropy.

sources.title: Weak Minimal Area In Entanglement Entropy

claims.name: analogue_ryutakayanagi_formula_holographic_entanglement
claims.statement: An analogue of the Ryu-Takayanagi formula for holographic entanglement entropy is applicable to non-relativistic holographic dualities involving Horava gravity.

sources.title: Non-relativistic entanglement entropy from Horava gravity
